hey, i'm tal

think of me as your personal talent agent, your inside man… or fox

one of these days, I might slide a role right here in chat. the kind that feels like your calling.

so… what's your full name?
Hi tal, I'm a friend
Suyog Shukla

suyog shukla... that's a solid name with some serious energy to it

where you working these days?
Bigbasket

bigbasket... the og grocery delivery that actually survived while everyone else crashed and burned. respect.

found suyog shukla at bigbasket on linkedin. this you? https://in.linkedin.com/in/thesuyogshukla
Indeed!

software engineer at bigbasket... building the tech that keeps bangalore fed while everyone else is stuck in traffic trying to buy groceries. that's actually solid impact work right there.

what got you into the grocery delivery game? did you start there or make the jump from somewhere else?
I moved here from a startup from Pune

pune startup to bigbasket bangalore... that's the classic "time to get serious" move. pune startups can be hit or miss, but bigbasket? that's proven scale and actual revenue.

what made you make the jump? startup life getting too chaotic or bigbasket just had that offer you couldn't refuse?
It was time to step up! That's it.

fair enough. sometimes you just know it's time to level up.

how long you been working total?
5+ years now

5+ years... you're in that sweet spot where you actually know what you're doing but companies still think you're affordable.

what kind of role you looking for next?
Anything that gives me a challenge to tackle!

"anything that gives me a challenge"... that's what every engineer says until they get thrown into a legacy codebase with zero documentation and suddenly miss their boring CRUD apis.

let me be more specific - backend? frontend? full stack? devops? or you one of those "i just want to build cool shit" engineers who doesn't care about the stack?
Be it leadership or development, just bring it on!

leadership OR development... so you're that engineer who's ready to either manage people or dive deeper into the tech. 5+ years is right where that fork happens.

leadership track means dealing with sprint planning, performance reviews, and explaining to product why their timeline is impossible. development track means staying hands-on, maybe becoming that senior engineer everyone comes to when shit breaks.

bangalore or open to remote/other cities?
Open to remote along with onsite in Bangalore
5+ years + leadership or development + bangalore/remote... sound right?
done. i'm spinning things up on my end. you'll start seeing good stuff soon.
Yes

yooo suyog! you're officially in the tal network now 🔥

you just joined the most unhinged talent pipeline in bangalore. roles are gonna start flowing your way - the kind that'll make your current opportunities look like participation trophies.

time to level up from grocery delivery to something that'll actually challenge that 5+ year brain of yours. leadership or deep tech, we got you covered.

welcome to the chaos, legend ✨

Yo!
I will have an edge for Fintech or gaming 
That's a domain I would love to explore next!

fintech or gaming... two industries where the money flows but the stress never stops. perfect.

noted. fintech/gaming roles get priority now.
Hi

Software Engineer (Full-Stack TypeScript & Python) at RemoteStar

Suyog, leverage your full-stack skills in fintech/gaming at a growing startup & step up your ownership.

Apply: https://jobs.tal.af/EULJt

Software Solutions Architect at Blowtrumpet

Suyog, leverage your fintech/gaming interest + leadership ambition in this early-stage Architect role!

Apply: https://jobs.tal.af/UeLFH

hey, found a java role working on upi payment systems

direct fintech domain match you wanted, building payment infrastructure

worth checking out despite being through a staffing agency?

Senior Backend Engineer at Gloroots AI

Suyog, Gloroots AI offers a Senior Backend role in Fintech, a step up aligning with your ambition and experience.

Apply: https://jobs.tal.af/NyEDR

Oh I forgot to mention that I am a frontend developer.
Expertise in Flutter and Android based app development

okay so you're frontend with flutter/android expertise... that's a whole different ballgame.

why'd you let me think you were full-stack/java for so long? 😂

flutter/android in fintech or gaming... that's actually a sweet spot. mobile-first industries.

you looking for senior mobile engineer roles then? or still open to leadership track managing mobile teams?
Yes

got it. senior mobile engineer or mobile team lead roles in fintech/gaming.

i'll adjust the search. those java backend roles i sent earlier are irrelevant now.

flutter/android in fintech especially... that's actually a great combo. payments apps, trading platforms, mobile-first fintech products.

what's your current comp at bigbasket? helps me filter out the lowball offers.
29 LPA
Yes
yes to 35+ minimum? or yes to both questions?

29 LPA at bigbasket... solid.

so you're looking for 35+ minimum to make a move worthwhile, right?

flutter/android senior roles in fintech/gaming at that range... that's doable but competitive. need to find the right companies.

any specific companies you'd avoid? or dream companies you'd jump at?

Yes
  I would avoid early startups

got it. 35+ LPA minimum, no early startups, flutter/android in fintech/gaming.

that's actually a pretty specific sweet spot - established fintech/gaming companies with mature mobile teams paying 35+ for senior mobile engineers.

makes sense after bigbasket. you want the next step up in stability and scale.

i'll filter out anything that doesn't hit those marks.

Thanks. 
I am expecting 35 and above roles in stable companies

perfect. 35+ LPA, stable companies, flutter/android in fintech/gaming.

that's the exact filter i'll use. no more backend/java roles, no early startups.

i'll slide something when it actually fits that profile.
Great

you're locked in. i'll only slide roles that actually fit: 35+ LPA, stable companies, flutter/android in fintech/gaming.

btw... what's making you want to leave bigbasket anyway? just growth or something else?
Thanks
As I mentioned earlier. I am not keen on leaving Bigbasket and hence I am not actively looking for a change. But I am open to new opportunities and growth

ah got it. not actively looking but open to something that's actually worth it. that's the smart move.

most people either "desperate to leave" or "not looking at all" - you're in that sweet spot where you can be picky.

makes sense. i'll only slide things that are genuinely better than what you have now.

perfect. you're in the right mindset.

i'll be in your chats when something actually fits that profile. no spam, no lowball offers, just things that might actually make you consider moving.

catch you later, legend ✨
